title: Chapter 331 Seeing Through Everything
content:
Chapter 331 Seeing Through Everything

"Nothing does it matter?"

"Hahahahaha!"

Chen Yu, not far away, seemed to have heard some big joke and suddenly burst into laughter.

Seeing this, Yan Lingyun and Lu Daosheng both frowned slightly.

At this moment, Chen Yu suddenly smiled and said, "If I say that all your experiences are caused by me?"

"What did you say?!"

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun's breath changed and she stared at Chen Yu in the distance.

On the side, Lu Daosheng remained silent and had already begun to deduce silently.

He has now discovered something is wrong.

Maybe he missed something after coming to the other side of the starry sky.

"Ye Lingzhi, have you never been curious about why the young palace master of the Dome Heavenly Palace, who had been practicing all day long and never left the door, suddenly fell in love with you?"

Chen Yu looked at Yan Lingyun in the distance with fun and said with a faint smile.

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun was stunned and her face suddenly became extremely ugly.

"You're the one who did it!"

Yes, she had never even met the young palace master of the Dome Heavenly Palace before. How could she fall in love at first sight? She would not marry?

It turned out that someone was secretly making trouble.

So, when she killed that guy, she was a little unfair.

But at this moment, Yan Lingyun still hated Chen Yu more.

"Why do you do this? As far as I know, I don't seem to have any connection with you."

Yan Lingyun clenched her fists, stared at Chen Yu in the distance, and said gritting her teeth.

Chen Yu was a little surprised that Yan Lingyun did not attack him directly.

But soon he understood.

Haha, it seems that the hardships experienced over the years have made the proudest Ye clan genius in front of him lose his former sharpness.

"Actually, it's not without origin."

Chen Yu smiled slightly, "Do you think, except for you, who will be the first person in the younger generation on the other side of the starry sky?"

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun couldn't believe it.

In addition to her, Chen Yu is naturally the first young man on the other side of the starry sky.

But what she couldn't believe was that Chen Yu was such a person.

Chen Yu was indeed very outstanding back then, but he was born in the same era as Ye Lingzhi.

Faced with the despair that he could only be second, Chen Yu chose to take action.

At this time, Yan Lingyun had slowly closed her eyes.

"Sure enough, jealousy can make people unrecognizable."

Hearing this, Chen Yu in the distance laughed again.

"I am jealous? Yes, I am the extreme, so what? The person who succeeds in the end is me, not you!"

Chen Yu was almost crazy at this moment, with a hideous smile on his face.

"To tell you the truth, the other side of the starry sky is now all under my control, including the entire Nether Sea."

After saying that, Chen Yu looked at Yan Lingyun, looking forward to Yan Lingyun's shocked face.

But he was disappointed.

At this moment, Yan Lingyun had no expression on her face and was very cold. She just looked at him with a hint of sadness.

This scene made him feel insulted.

He has worked hard for so many years, but the results have not been recognized.

Especially, the one in front of him was the one he wanted to surpass day and night.

"Ye Lingzhi, you are back now and you can't change anything."

As he said that, Chen Yu raised his palm and a stream of deep material like a black hole emerged.

In an instant, everything around began to gradually dissipate.

"Do you know what this is?"

"This is the power of nothingness. I used this power to even kill the heavenly way on the other side of the starry sky. Even the old guy in the dome sky died tragically under the power of nothingness."

"Now, you surrender to me will be your only chance now."

Chen Yu was jealous and hated Yan Lingyun, but he naturally admired him very much.

He believed that Yan Lingyun was a smart person and would definitely make the right choice.

And at this moment, a sigh sounded from Yan Lingyun.

"What an unexpected surprise."

Lu Daosheng looked calm and looked at Chen Yu in the distance.

Suddenly, Chen Yu's body suddenly tense and was even more shocked.

"Who are you?"

Chen Yu faced Lu Daosheng beside Yan Lingyun for the first time.

From the beginning, he thought Lu Daosheng was just a follower next to Yan Lingyun, like a follower.

But at this moment, he discovered it.

Otherwise, the man in front of him would be a strong man who was hidden!

Facing Chen Yu's questioning, Lu Daosheng did not answer, but said lightly: "You raised the Spirit-Devouring Clan and the Nawutuo Clan, right?"

Upon hearing this, Chen Yu's eyes shrank, but he still said with a smile: "What are you talking about, why can't I understand?"

Lu Daosheng chuckled and continued, "You can actually blame the Spirit-Devouring Clan on the Palace of Void. I have to say, you really have some strength."

"I think there should be people in the Void Palace who support you, right?"

Hearing this, Chen Yu's heart had already stormy waves.

Why do people in front of you know everything? !

He can admit the matter of the Wutuo clan, but the matter of the Spirit-Devouring Clan is absolutely not possible, because if the matter is known by the Void Palace, he will inevitably be punished by the Void Palace.

After all, the Palace of Void will never sit idly by and watch when cultivating disaster forces.

However, it is obvious that he did not know about the revenge of Lu Daosheng in the Void Palace.

He only knew that the brother-in-law Songzhe, the owner of the Xuwu Palace who was blamed by him, fell inexplicably.

In response to this, he just thought it was discovered by the Palace of Void and destroyed his relatives for justice.

I would never think that it was the man in front of me who did it.

The Xuwu Palace was scrambled by Lu Daosheng, and the Xuwu Palace obviously concealed it for the sake of his face.

At this moment, the entire starry sky suddenly trembled.

For a moment, all the living beings on the other side of the starry sky were frightened and anxious.

What's going on?

Chen Yu's face also changed drastically and he looked up suddenly.

Suddenly, countless gaps suddenly broke on the other side of the starry sky, revealing the hideous chaotic void inside.

The next moment, an angry voice came to the other side of the starry sky with a terrifying aura.

"Ant, you are looking for death, but even my Xuwu Palace dares to blame him!!"

boom!

At this moment, the entire starry sky was boiling.

Palace of Nothingness!

It turned out to be the Palace of Nothingness.

That is one of the five major order halls.

A force that is above all else.

At this time, Chen Yu's face was already pale and his face was bloodless.

He never expected that he could still be seen through the hidden things he did.

Chen Yu looked at Lu Daosheng suddenly, his eyes full of hatred.

However, before he could speak.

The powerful men of the Void Palace had already appeared around Chen Yu and surrounded him.

The terrifying pressure instantly crushed Chen Yu to the ground.

Such a luxurious lineup can be said to be a killer to kill a chicken.

But it is precisely this that deeply demonstrates the anger of the Palace of Void.

The head of the Xuwu Palace, Xuwuzi, came in person.

"The Lord of the Palace of Xuwu Palace, Xuwuzi, has met the Lord."

"See you sir!"

Xu Wuzi and the powerful people in the Xu Wu Palace worshiped Lu Daosheng directly.

But at this moment, there was a hint of anger on their faces.

And this anger is only aimed at one person.

That is Chen Yu, who was already dead in the distance.
